QuestInfo.name: Ravana the Demon
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Dao the monk at #m252030000#. Maybe he's the person that Master Loong was talking about?
QuestInfo.1: You met Dao the monk at #m252030000#. He told you he recently fled from Ravana because he was unable to keep up, though he was close to defeating the demon. The door to the altar hasn't closed yet. Go in his place and destroy #bRavana the Demon#k.
QuestInfo.2: You sealed away #bRavana the Demon#k, but Dao said that Ravana would be back. He warned you that for the peace of Golden Temple, you must find allies and fight Ravana to prevent its evil from escaping the temple.

0.0: How did you get here? Wait, that's not important. You need to get to the Golden Altar and finish off Ravana! I wrestled with him for so long and finally got him cornered, but I don't have the energy to finish him off.
0.1: He's trapped at the Gold Altar. You just need to finish him off! Quickly, while the gate is still open!

yes.0: Use the portal to your left to find Ravana.

no.0: Please! You've come this far, so you must be strong enough to face Ravana!

1.0: Thank you! Because of you, Ravana is no longer a threat. But, who are you? \r\n#L0##bMy name is #h0#. Master Loong sent me to help you.#l\n#k
1.1: Master Loong, insightful as always. I have never met anyone as wise as he is. Thank you again for your help.

yes.0: But Ravana has not given up, I fear. The next time he awakens, you might not be able to handle him alone...

mob.0: Use the portal to your left to find Ravana.
